guard_rules: idempotency_key required when reward_policy in (live_gated, live) or progress_policy in (live_gated, live)
missing idempotency_key with live policy -> HTTP 400 idempotency_key_required_for_live_gated_or_live
reward_policy=live not honored when REWARD_LIVE_ENABLED=false -> coerced to preview
reward_policy=live_gated not honored when REWARD_LIVE_ENABLED=false -> coerced to preview
progress_policy=live not honored when PROGRESS_LIVE_ENABLED=false -> coerced to preview
battle_engine_mode=authoritative not honored when BATTLE_LAUNCH_AUTHORITATIVE_ENABLED=false -> coerced to preview
server_id required even with flag off (used for echo + audit trail)
no DB writes regardless of flags in v107A endpoint implementation
idempotency_key_format: opaque string min 1 char (e.g. uuid v4)
idempotency_dedupe_window_when_live: server-side dedupe TBD in v111 economy live canary pack
